name: CreateCardSmsTemplate

parameters.help_en: The name of the card SMS template
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
The content of the card SMS template.

For descriptions of fields such as Template, ExtendInfo, TemplateContent, TmpCard, and Action, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434929.html.
The content structure varies depending on the type of card SMS template. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/435361.html
parameters.help_zh:
卡片短信的模板内容。

Template、ExtendInfo、TemplateContent、TmpCard、Action等字段说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434929.html。
不同类型的卡片短信模板的内容结构不同，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/435361.html
parameters.name: template

parameters.help_en: The description of the uploaded template
parameters.name: memo

parameters.help_en:
The manufacturers to which the template is submitted. Valid values:

HuaWei: Huawei.
XiaoMi: Xiaomi.
OPPO: OPPO.
VIVO: VIVO.
MEIZU: Meizu.
HONOR: Honor.

If this parameter is not specified, the system automatically matches the mobile phone manufacturers that support the template
parameters.help_zh:
模板提交的厂商。厂商类型取值：

HuaWei：表示华为厂商。
XiaoMi：表示小米厂商。
OPPO：表示OPPO厂商。
VIVO：表示VIVO厂商。
MEIZU：表示魅族厂商。
HONOR：表示荣耀厂商。

该参数不填时，系统自动匹配模板支持的手机厂商
parameters.name: factorys
